name: plan-tracker
description: Your approved plan, live: which step is done, running, or waiting on you. A one-row band above the prompt (plan, state word, progress bar, Plan file) and a pane with lanes of task cards, a state word (In progress, Idle, Done) after the plan name in the header, the plan dropdown and the band, big figures under the plan name (time, tokens, cost) and on each task page, task pages (a labelled table: goal, status, who, progress, note, deliverable) and a deliverables table (long lists fold into +N more, a narrow pane stacks each file with its change under its path), in the terminal and the Claude Desktop app. It reads PROGRESS.md (or the output of a command you set) and redraws whenever it changes. Read-only.

board_location.title: Board location
board_location.description: The board file, relative to the project root. Same meaning as plan-orchestrator's board_location.

board_command.title: Board command (optional)
board_command.description: A command that prints the board as JSON, used instead of the file. Placeholders: {session} is the session id, {query} the /plans argument; [ ... ] around words keeps them only when every placeholder inside is non-empty, e.g. mytool --view {session} --json [--query={query}]. No shell runs it.

usage_command.title: Usage command (optional)
usage_command.description: A command that records a task's time and cost when its page opens; the board command then returns them. Placeholders: {session} {anchor} {index} {task}. Empty: cost and time are hidden.

your_name.title: Your name (optional)
your_name.description: A row whose executor or checker equals this name is shown as 'you', and its cost is hidden. Empty: nothing is shown as you.
